WITH old_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT rowid AS id, local_path, dropbox_path, dropbox_key_delta,{CommitterKeyOf}local_path) AS local_key FROM synced_entry WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM synced_entry INDEXED BY synced_local_key WHERE pair_id = {PairTablePairKey} AND {CommitterKeyOf}local_path) >= $localLow AND {CommitterKeyOf}local_path) < $localHigh UNION ALL SELECT rowid FROM synced_entry INDEXED BY synced_dropbox_key WHERE pair_id = {PairTablePairKey} AND dropbox_key_delta >= $remoteLow AND dropbox_key_delta < $remoteHigh UNION ALL SELECT rowid FROM synced_entry INDEXED BY synced_local_key WHERE pair_id = {PairTablePairKey} AND {CommitterKeyOf}local_path) >= $remoteLow AND {CommitterKeyOf}local_path) < $remoteHigh AND dropbox_key_delta IS NULL)), final_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id,
    CASE WHEN local_key >= $localLow AND local_key < $localHigh
      THEN $newLocalPath || substr(local_path, length($oldLocalPath) + 1)
      ELSE local_path END AS local_path,
    CASE WHEN local_key >= $localLow AND local_key < $localHigh
      THEN $newLocalKey || substr(local_key, length($oldLocalKey) + 1)
      ELSE local_key END AS local_key,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(dropbox_key_delta, local_key) >= $remoteLow
        AND coalesce(dropbox_key_delta, local_key) < $remoteHigh
      THEN $newDropboxPath || substr(dropbox_path, length($oldDropboxPath) + 1)
      ELSE dropbox_path END AS dropbox_path,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(dropbox_key_delta, local_key) >= $remoteLow
        AND coalesce(dropbox_key_delta, local_key) < $remoteHigh
      THEN $newDropboxKey || substr(coalesce(dropbox_key_delta, local_key), length($oldDropboxKey) + 1)
      ELSE coalesce(dropbox_key_delta, local_key) END AS dropbox_key
  FROM old_rows)
